terminals.name: social-api
terminals.description: FastAPI backend on http://localhost:8000 (Swagger UI at /docs). Tables auto-create on startup and an admin user is seeded from .env.local.
terminals.command: cd social-automation/backend && set -a && source .env.local && set +a && source .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: social-frontend
terminals.description: Next.js frontend on http://localhost:3001. Proxies /api/v1/* to the backend via API_INTERNAL_URL.
terminals.command: cd social-automation/frontend && API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:8000 npm run dev
